contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 4
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the complete authorized Rework 3 intermediate state and continue it without reset, stash, checkout, revert or loss.
Preserve the accepted TASK-0122 visual Dashboard implementation; do not change its layout or broaden product behavior.
Fix the routed Finding-to-Dashboard integration test through deterministic router and asynchronous synchronization with correct cleanup; do not merely raise the timeout.
Use React Router state coherently so Finding selection, Sidebar Dashboard navigation, Back and Forward are deterministic and URL-authoritative without global-history test races.
Update the seven existing Finding Threat Intelligence tests to establish an explicit canonical URL findingId before rendering and to clean up URL state.
Do not restore implicit first-Finding selection or change production behavior to satisfy obsolete tests.
On every URL findingId change, reset all Finding-dependent Explanation, Threat Intelligence, linked-Incident, loading, error and derived detail state before data for the new Finding may be used.
Dashboard remains the fail-closed canonical validation boundary and manipulated findingId values must not display data belonging to another Finding.
Run the complete frontend regression, TypeScript validation, production build and git diff --check; all validators must pass before REVIEW publication.
Do not introduce synthetic data, backend changes, provider execution, another routing architecture, broader lifecycle transitions or TASK-0123.
